ruleDefinitions.name: Wab Execution From Non Default Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of wab.exe (Windows Contacts) and Wabmig.exe (Microsoft Address Book Import Tool) from non default locations as seen with bumblebee activity

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\wab\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wabmig\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Mail\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Mail\\\\")))
